verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs say custom domains "get SSL certificates automatically," and the CLI can manage certificates, so automatic TLS provisioning is a first-party capability. The pack never says the certificates are free, that they renew automatically, or that wildcard domains are covered. missing for 10: documented free pricing for certificates, automatic renewal, wildcard certificate support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Add a custom domain, manage DNS records, and get SSL certificates automatically.
enabling you to retrieve logs, manage certificates, replicate your deployment environment locally, manage Domain Name System (DNS) records, and more.
